Hi Alex,

Thanks again for making time on short notice. Our external auditors are starting a desk review next week and asked for the following artifacts by EOD Monday:

- The current Incident Response Plan (PDF) with an evidence index that maps each control to supporting artifacts (logs, runbooks, retention policy).
